spec_features.notes: End-to-end: tool exposed to model, dispatched, and the loop honors it as a terminating stop.

The system prompt explicitly tells the model to 'treat that as a normal constraint of the environment' for read-only files, and the read-only refusal text (tools.py:23 READONLY_MESSAGE) is a neutral 'Permission denied... read-only'.
